# Holzen

> Volatility-triggered pause practice for investors. When Bitcoin moves, Holzen helps you pause before you act — AI-generated reflections, breathing, and behavioral insights. Not financial advice.

Holzen watches Bitcoin volatility (v1) and sends gentle pause prompts. We don't recommend buying, selling, or holding anything — we help you notice your impulse, feel it, and choose with intention. Built by a small husband-and-wife team.

## Pages

- [Welcome](/welcome): Landing page — what Holzen is, how it works, pricing, FAQ.
- [About](/about): Why we built Holzen, behavioral-finance research, and why we start with Bitcoin.
